home.title: All your links in one place
home.lead: Bio pages, short links, QR codes and analytics. Free software.
auth.name: Name
auth.welcome: Done! Your account is ready. We sent you an email to verify it.
auth.2fa_body: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.verify_invalid: The verification link is invalid or has expired.
auth.verify_sent: We sent you another verification email.
auth.verify_banner: You haven't verified your email yet.
auth.forgot_body: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
auth.forgot_sent: If there's an account with that email, a reset link is on its way. It expires in one hour.
auth.reset_invalid: The link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
auth.reset_done: Password updated. You can log in now.
mail.verify_body:
Hi,

To verify your email open this link:
{link}

If you didn't create a tubio account, ignore this message.
mail.reset_body:
Hi,

To set a new password open this link (it expires in one hour):
{link}

If you didn't ask for this, ignore this message: your password stays the same.
admin.impersonating: You are viewing the account of {email}.
err.csrf: The form session expired. Reload the page and try again.
err.email_taken: There's already an account with that email.
err.password_short: The password must be at least 10 characters.
err.404_body: This page doesn't exist or is no longer available.
err.500_body: We had a problem. Please try again in a moment.
account.title: My account
account.email_unverified: Email not verified. If you change it we'll send you a new link.
account.saved_email: Changes saved. We sent you a link to verify the new email.
account.password_changed: Password changed. We signed out your other sessions.
account.2fa_intro: Besides your password, ask for a code from an authenticator app (Aegis, Google Authenticator, 1Password…).
account.2fa_step1: Scan this code with your authenticator app.
account.2fa_step2: Enter the 6-digit code it shows to confirm.
account.export_body: Download as JSON everything you have on tubio: links, blocks, QR codes, projects and daily stats.
account.delete_body: Your account, links, pages, QR codes, files and stats are deleted. This can't be undone.
account.delete_confirm: Delete your account and everything in it? This can't be undone.
err.upload_not_image: The file isn't a valid image (PNG, JPG, WEBP, GIF or AVIF).
